reviewed: defects surfaced by re-running the engine check after the read
_finding: Two of them I introduced: promoting carisma and innovatore to noun in 009 and 011 without giving them a noun_class, so getNounForms returned null and the entries silently lost their articles. The third is pre-existing: andarsene is pronominal in -ne rather than -si, so the reflexive helper does not recognise it and the participle rule fell through to its fallback.

rows._note: ends in -e, so the engine derives gli innovatori on its own
masculine despite the -a ending, like pigiama and problema; the regular rules cannot get carismi from carisma

rows._was: the participle came out as 'andarseneato'. andarsene is built on andare with the clitics ne + si, and isReflexiveInfinitive only matches -arsi/-ersi/-irsi, so the stem was never reduced. Supplying the participle and auxiliary directly sidesteps the whole derivation.
